items.provider: SENASICA (Programa Mascota Viajero Frecuente)
items.basis: six-month import certificate for frequent travellers with dogs/cats
items.note: Press release of 2018-11-14: 'El programa es gratuito'. Secondhand sources (Mexican consulate pages) say the ordinary import certificate is free for 1-2 pets and payable from 3 pets; SENASICA's X account says the pet export certificate (Certificado Zoosanitario de Exportación) is free, valid 8 days (https://x.com/SENASICA/status/1563330454085828609, not read directly).
